prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. One old unplugged vending machine reused as storage cabinet, faded ochre metal frame and charcoal glassless front panel held closed, inset dark shelves dimly visible behind dull panel, patched lower slot, no visible food brands, text, light or power. Square .85x.85tile base and height78px at tile144. Broad readable shapes, a few use marks, closed unsearched. Outside silhouette must be fully transparent: no halo, glow, smoky backdrop or drop shadow. Keep large areas of original color; wear only around use points, not everywhere.
